verdict: Fundamental bull thesis intact despite June 23 semiconductor rout (KOSPI -9.99%, MU -13%); MU earnings tonight is the pivotal 2027-cycle print; CRDO +10.79% and HIVE +25% on real catalysts; B200 lease price -31% is the key near-term bear flag.

## Fresh developments (last 24-72h)

**Sig 1 — DRAM pricing:** Q2 2026 conventional DRAM contract +58-63% QoQ; mobile DRAM +93-98% QoQ (TrendForce). HBM3E ASPs raised ~20% for 2026 by SK Hynix/Samsung. Memflation accelerating.

**Sig 2 — HBM4 ramp:** SK Hynix shipped HBM4E samples June 18 (16Gbps/pin, 48GB 12-layer, +20% power efficiency vs. HBM4). Micron confirmed HBM4 in high-volume production for NVIDIA Vera Rubin; entire 2026 HBM sold out, attention shifting to 2027 allocation (key watch on tonight's earnings call). SK Hynix tactically slowing HBM4 to prioritize DDR5 margins — signals confidence in position, not demand softness. No supplier confirmation of "correction after 2026."

**Sig 3 — Hyperscaler capex:** Aggregate 2026 capex confirmed ~$725B — AMZN $200B, MSFT $190B, GOOGL $175-185B, META $115-135B. No guide-down. Bear flag: NVIDIA B200 GPU cloud lease rates collapsed -31% from $6.11→$4.22/hr (May 30–mid-June), suggesting spot compute getting long ahead of Vera Rubin ramp.

**Sig 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** AMD MI400/Helios confirmed on track H2-2026; "Advancing AI 2026" showcase July 22-23 with MI450. Acquired MEXT (memory optimization). Custom ASIC share ~28% of AI servers 2026, +44.6% CAGR.

**Sig 5 — Optical:** 800G transceivers 40-60% short of demand through 2027 (McKinsey). JX Advanced Metals committing ¥120B to InP substrate expansion. CPO market forecast >$39B by 2030 (TrendForce).

**Sig 6 — Solar:** FSLR -5.3% June 23 on TOPCon import investigation and tariff assumptions. Polysilicon ~$5.07/kg (oversupply). Residential solar ITC expired Dec 2025. ENPH launched IQ9N GaN microinverter June 23; exhibiting at Intersolar Europe. NXT acquiring Prevalon Energy ($365M, battery storage expansion).

## Context vs baseline

June 23 broad rout (KOSPI -9.99%, MU -13%, WDC -8.5%, MRVL -7.4%) was macro/valuation driven — Fed rate concerns and AI spending sustainability doubts — not fundamental deterioration. All supply-demand signals (HBM sold out, hyperscaler capex $725B, optical 40-60% short) remain on-thesis. CRDO's DustPhotonics acquisition is a noteworthy move up the photonics value chain. B200 lease pricing -31% is the first actionable near-term bear flag: spot GPU compute softening could signal inventory building ahead of Vera Rubin. Watch tonight's MU call for 2027 HBM allocation commentary.

## Most important development

**MU Q3 FY2026 earnings tonight** (after close) — HBM4 in high-volume production for NVIDIA Vera Rubin, 2026 fully sold out, stock down -13% on June 23 before +4.1% premarket recovery. If the call provides 2027 HBM allocation visibility and beats the ~$34.7B/$20 EPS consensus, it resets the memory supercycle narrative higher. A miss or weak 2027 commentary risks validating the correction-after-2026 thesis ahead of schedule.
